answer: An operator cannot safely forge identities in this PoA system: every identity posts bonded collateral, and authenticated evidence can link coordinated equivocation to a common controller. Controlling a sybil swarm of k coordinated identities makes penalties for correlated equivocation scale quadratically, O(k^2); upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases capital loss across the controller’s escrow. Thus labels such as velvet and yarrow increase exposure rather than dilute it.
